column1: The registration could not be completed.
This password appears in known data breaches, so attackers try it first. Please choose another one.
column2: Kata sandi ini muncul di kebocoran data yang diketahui, jadi penyerang mencobanya lebih dulu. Silakan pilih yang lain.

column1: Only when the whole shop works on HTTPS and will keep working: browsers remember it and refuse plain HTTP until it expires.
column2: Hanya jika seluruh toko berjalan di HTTPS dan akan tetap begitu: peramban mengingatnya dan menolak HTTP biasa sampai kedaluwarsa.

column1: Thank you. The owner of the shop will look at it and, if it was a mistake, let you through.
column2: Terima kasih. Pemilik toko akan memeriksanya dan, jika itu keliru, mengizinkan Anda lewat.

column1: This request was stopped for security reasons. If you think this is a mistake, tell the owner of the shop what you were doing:
column2: Permintaan ini dihentikan karena alasan keamanan. Jika Anda merasa ini keliru, beri tahu pemilik toko apa yang sedang Anda lakukan:

column1: Force HTTPS in browsers for 6 months (HSTS)
column2: Paksa HTTPS di peramban selama 6 bulan (HSTS)

column1: The password must have at least %1 characters.
column2: Kata sandi harus memiliki setidaknya %1 karakter.

column1: [%1] Someone asks you to review a firewall block
column2: [%1] Seseorang meminta Anda meninjau blokir firewall

column1: A visitor stopped by the firewall asks for a review. To let them through or not: bin/magento draco:reviews
column2: Pengunjung yang dihentikan firewall meminta peninjauan. Untuk mengizinkannya lewat atau tidak: bin/magento draco:reviews
Masuk, pendaftaran, dan semua yang dikirim

column1: Stops requests with the shape of an attack (database injection, reading server files, running code, scripts in links) and the scanners that look for weak spots. The admin panel is never inspected. Start with "Log only" for a few days. Emergency exit: 'draco_waf_off' => true in app/etc/env.php. Try it: bin/magento draco:test
column2: Menghentikan permintaan yang berbentuk serangan (injeksi basis data, membaca berkas server, menjalankan kode, skrip dalam tautan) dan pemindai yang mencari titik lemah. Panel admin tidak pernah diperiksa. Mulailah beberapa hari dengan "Hanya catat". Jalan keluar darurat: 'draco_waf_off' => true di app/etc/env.php. Coba: bin/magento draco:test

column1: Too many pages a minute from one address or one network get "429, come back in a minute". Customers who are logged in and search engines verified by DNS are never limited.
column2: Terlalu banyak halaman per menit dari satu alamat atau satu jaringan mendapat "429, kembali dalam satu menit". Pelanggan yang sudah masuk dan mesin pencari yang diverifikasi lewat DNS tidak pernah dibatasi.

column1: Adds an invisible trap and a signed page stamp to the "Create an Account" form, without captchas. Bots get no account; three bot attempts in one day block the address for a week.
column2: Menambahkan jebakan tak terlihat dan cap halaman bertanda tangan ke formulir "Buat Akun", tanpa captcha. Bot tidak mendapat akun; tiga percobaan bot dalam sehari memblokir alamat selama seminggu.

column1: Refuse or allow visitors by country, from a public list (DB-IP Lite, CC BY 4.0) downloaded once a month by cron and looked up locally. Behind Cloudflare its own country header is used.
column2: Tolak atau izinkan pengunjung menurut negara, dari daftar publik (DB-IP Lite, CC BY 4.0) yang diunduh cron sebulan sekali dan dicari secara lokal. Di belakang Cloudflare, header negaranya sendiri yang dipakai.

column1: Two-letter codes separated by commas, such as RU, CN.
column2: Kode dua huruf dipisahkan koma, misalnya RU, CN.

column1: Only change the header when the shop is behind that proxy. A header from any other connection is ignored, so nobody can pose as another address.
column2: Ubah header hanya jika toko berada di belakang proxy tersebut. Header dari koneksi lain diabaikan, jadi tidak ada yang bisa menyamar sebagai alamat lain.

column1: Addresses or CIDR ranges, separated by commas. Empty: this machine and private networks. Cloudflare's ranges are already known.
column2: Alamat atau rentang CIDR, dipisahkan koma. Kosong: mesin ini dan jaringan privat. Rentang Cloudflare sudah dikenal.

column1: CIDR ranges, one per line, added to the ones Draco knows.
column2: Rentang CIDR, satu per baris, ditambahkan ke yang sudah dikenal Draco.
Alamat yang tidak pernah diblokir atau dibatasi

column1: Separated by commas, on top of the last addresses administrators logged in from.
column2: Dipisahkan koma, selain alamat terakhir tempat administrator masuk.

column1: Start of the path, one per line, such as webhooks that receive signed payloads.
column2: Awal jalur, satu per baris, seperti webhook yang menerima data bertanda tangan.

column1: nosniff, SAMEORIGIN, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy. Draco never replaces a header the shop already sends.
column2: nosniff, SAMEORIGIN, Referrer-Policy, dan Permissions-Policy. Draco tidak pernah mengganti header yang sudah dikirim toko.

column1: Applied when a customer chooses a password: sign-up, account page, reset link and the API. Existing passwords keep working.
column2: Berlaku saat pelanggan memilih kata sandi: pendaftaran, halaman akun, tautan pengaturan ulang, dan API. Kata sandi yang sudah ada tetap berfungsi.

column1: Refuse passwords that appear in known data breaches
column2: Tolak kata sandi yang muncul dalam kebocoran data yang diketahui

column1: Asks Have I Been Pwned with only the first 5 characters of the password's SHA-1: the password never leaves your server. If the service does not answer in 3 seconds, the password is accepted.
column2: Bertanya ke Have I Been Pwned hanya dengan 5 karakter pertama SHA-1 kata sandi: kata sandi tidak pernah meninggalkan server Anda. Jika layanan tidak menjawab dalam 3 detik, kata sandi diterima.

column1: Visitors stopped by the firewall can ask for a review from the block page. You get at most one e-mail an hour; decide with bin/magento draco:reviews.
column2: Pengunjung yang dihentikan firewall dapat meminta peninjauan dari halaman blokir. Anda menerima paling banyak satu e-mail per jam; putuskan dengan bin/magento draco:reviews.

column1: Empty: the store's general contact e-mail.
